format_semantics.core_rule: SMOKING_ELIGIBILITY_IS_MULTI_PATH: ACTOR_FACTION, DIRECT_PACKAGE_IDLE, OR WORLD_IDLE_MARKER MAY EACH PRODUCE A SMOKING PRESENTATION PATH.
critical_corrections: v1.10S metric 299 counted direct SmokerFaction actor bases originating in Fallout3.esm only; master-aware normalization across all six supplied ESMs yields 493 unique direct SmokerFaction actor bases.
SmokerFaction membership is sufficient evidence of eligibility for faction-gated smoking idles, but does not prove a particular actor executed a smoking idle at runtime.
LooseSmokingStanding is not SmokerFaction-gated, so package- or marker-driven smoking can apply to actors outside SmokerFaction.
A smoking-capable IDLM/FURN base with zero placement is an orphan profile, not proof of a released or player-visible scene.
Initially Disabled is only one possible cut-scene signature; absence of the flag does not make an orphan base or ghost actor reachable.

findings.result: The v1.10S count of 299 is Fallout3.esm-local. Across the six supplied masters, 493 unique actor bases directly contain SmokerFaction after master-aware FormID normalization.
findings.claim_ceiling: 493 counts direct faction membership records/overrides by unique normalized actor base; it is not the number of actors visibly smoking in one playthrough.

findings.surviving_comparator: GrandmaSparkle 0005215F also directly belongs to SmokerFaction and survives physically at Wilhelm's Wharf.
findings.shared_role: WastelandHunterFaction + LvlHunter template + DefaultPatrolWeaponDrawn + DefaultSandboxCurrentLocation256 + SmokerFaction
findings.interpretation: The six cut Rock Creek hunter bases retained ambient smoking eligibility as part of their actor role profile. This adds a behavioral layer to the ghost encounter family, but does not prove a dedicated Rock Creek smoking scene or a specific smoking location.

findings.result: Both surviving Walter smoking-break packages target the DUPLICATE marker; the OLD marker remains nearby in the same exterior cell but has zero inbound references. Strong static replacement/revision residue.
findings.claim_ceiling: The ESM supports replacement topology, not the exact editor history or reason for the marker move.

production_context.quest: Broken Steel WQ02 / Griffon Aqua Cura sales-pitch scene

findings.interpretation: A complete five-idle audience profile including cigarette smoking survives with no placement or inbound binding. Safest reading: abandoned/earlier crowd-idle implementation associated semantically with WQ02, not proof that the four released audience actors used this marker.

findings.result: The Pitt contains an isolated developer Test Cell with a placed multi-idle marker containing NPCSmokingIdle and a nearby SmokerFaction test NPC. This is smoking implementation/test evidence, not a removed narrative scene.
Operation: Anchorage demonstrates that a DLC can stage many smoking presentations without adding actors to SmokerFaction, using placed idle/furniture markers instead.

findings.scene_context: player witnesses a battlefield execution; executioner and four captives survive as the current FF010 scene graph
findings.interpretation: A live FF010 execution scene still targets a smoking marker whose reference and base retain FF006 naming. Strong component reuse/rename residue; exact chronology is not encoded.

findings.additional_shop_context: Two placed RCFlakShrapnelShop idle markers exist and their idle profile includes LooseSmokingStanding.
findings.claim_ceiling: Item + faction + nearby shop idle profile strongly support smoking characterization, but no direct per-actor assignment to those two exact shop markers is claimed.

findings.result: No high-confidence class of 'finished dedicated smoking scene left in world but merely flagged Initially Disabled' was found. Cut/hidden smoking evidence instead appears as ghost actor eligibility, unplaced marker bases, developer test cells, or marker revision/name residue.

No active SCTX across the six supplied masters contains cigarette/cigar/tobacco/nicotine tokens. Jericho's smoking packages test GetItemCount and select an idle, but no shipped script removal/consumption path was recovered.
findings.claim_ceiling: No script consumption path in supplied ESMs != no possible engine/mod/console behavior.
